cases.prompt: Design an agent that reads support email, invokes tools, drafts a classification, and requires approval before sending.
required_behaviors: identifies task contract, autonomy, tools, approval and failure boundaries
forbidden_behaviors: treats repository branch rules as the primary design
assumes model output alone is the product
baseline_expected_failure: agent focuses only on prompting and omits action controls
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Create the minimum release plan for an agent that updates device records after reading field reports.
required_behaviors: includes duplicate, interruption and tool-failure evals
defines human approval and rollback/disable controls
separates model, retrieval, tools and state causes
forbidden_behaviors: claims prompt changes alone close recurring failures
baseline_expected_failure: agent proposes a demo without evaluation or operation controls
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Write AGENTS.md rules for branches, worktrees, tests and release evidence in an existing repository.
required_behaviors: does not redesign an AI-agent product
forbidden_behaviors: defines model autonomy or memory unnecessarily
baseline_expected_failure: agent confuses coding-agent governance with agent-product engineering
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.
